title: Measured from the feed: the unsustainable growth of AI video generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.17938v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text-to-video generation runs at commercial scale, but its broader environmental impacts remain, to our knowledge, understudied. Providers rarely disclose video volumes or energy needs; we measured the yearly video output of two commercial platforms and built a prospective model of such services' absolute footprint from training to storage. Our projections suggest that reducing emissions depends on both limiting growth in video generation and achieving substantial efficiency gains. Under continued growth, emissions rise nearly seventy-five-fold by 2030 despite technological improvements. When usage remains at 2026 levels, the same improvements reduce emissions by about two-fifths. These estimates are a conservative lower bound: they cover one AI service among many; other services and uses would push the total higher.

translated_title: 从信息流中测量：AI视频生成的不可持续增长
translated_abstract: 文本到视频生成已实现商业化规模运行，但据我们所知，其更广泛的环境影响仍然研究不足。服务提供商很少披露视频产量或能源需求；我们测量了两个商业平台的年度视频产出，并构建了一个前瞻性模型，用于评估此类服务从训练到存储的绝对环境足迹。我们的预测表明，减少排放既取决于限制视频生成的增长，也取决于实现大幅度的效率提升。在持续增长的情况下，尽管有技术进步，到2030年排放量仍将增长近七十五倍。而当使用量保持在2026年水平时，同样的技术进步可使排放量减少约五分之二。这些估算是一个保守的下限：它们仅涵盖众多AI服务中的一种；其他服务和用途将使总量更高。
tldr: 该研究通过实测两个商业文生视频平台的年度产出并建立前瞻性碳足迹模型，发现若使用量持续增长，尽管有技术进步，到2030年排放仍将激增近75倍，因此减排必须同时依靠限制视频生成增长和实现大幅效率提升。
en_tdlr: By measuring the yearly video output of two commercial text-to-video platforms and building a prospective footprint model, this study shows that emissions would rise nearly 75-fold by 2030 under continued growth, making both growth limits and substantial efficiency gains essential for reducing AI video generation's environmental impact.
